# Ludwerk API reference

Every class, datatype, enum and library of the scripting API. The pages are
generated from the same definitions as the engine and the editor's type
information, so they always match the engine they ship with.

For the reasoning behind the API, read [`../api-design.md`](../api-design.md).
For a guided tour, read [`../migrating.md`](../migrating.md).

- [Datatypes](datatypes.md): `CFrame`, `Color3`, `UDim2`, `Signal` and others
- [Enums](enums.md)
- [Libraries and globals](libraries.md): `task` and the global functions
